title: qPCR Preparation with 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol preps a 384 well BIO-RAD plate for PCR. The protocol can be considered in 3 main parts: * cDNA is added to the SuperMix and mixed * Resulting solution (mastermix) is added to each well in the 384 well PCR plate * Primer is added to each well in the 384 well plate Since this protocol relies on the transfer of small amounts of liquid (in some cases 1ul transfers), aspiration and dispense flow rates are slowed, as well as incorporating blowout steps and proper aspiration/dispense heights to ensure proper distribution. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: Specify the number of primer pairs you will be running in this run (1-12, and wholly divisible by 2). A value of 2 will provide enough primer for 4 columns on the 384 well PCR plate, a value of 4 will accommodate 8 columns, and so forth. * `cDNA Column`: Specify which columns the cDNA will be hosted in Slot 4 of the deck. Select `0` for column 2 if only running one cDNA column. * `Aspiration height from well bottom`: Specify (in mm) the distance above the well bottom all aspirations steps will aspirate from. * `Dispense height from well bottom`: Specify (in mm) the distance above the well bottom all dispense steps will dispense from. * `Aspiration flow rate for P10-Multi (ul/sec)`: Specify the aspiration flow rate for the P10-Multi. * `Aspiration flow rate for P50-Multi (ul/sec)`: Specify the aspiration flow rate for the P50-Multi. * `Dispense flow rate for P10-Multi (ul/sec)`: Specify the dispense flow rate for the P10-Multi. * `Dispense flow rate for P50-Multi (ul/sec)`: Specify the dispense flow rate for the P50-Multi. * `Use Temperature Module`: If `Yes` is selected, the temperature module will be engaged over the course of the protocol with the user-specified temperature. A selection of `No` disengages the temperature module over the course of the protocol. * `Temperature Module Temperature`: Specify the temperature the temperature module will hold over the duration of the

steps.title: Configure instrument settings
steps.instruction: Set all liquid‑handling parameters before starting: specify the Number of Samples (1‑12, must be divisible by 2); choose the cDNA Column (slot 4) and set to 0 for column 2 if only one cDNA column is used; define Aspiration height from well bottom (mm) and Dispense height from well bottom (mm); set Aspiration flow rates for P10‑Multi and P50‑Multi (µL/sec) and Dispense flow rates for P10‑Multi and P50‑Multi (µL/sec); decide whether to Use Temperature Module (Yes/No) and, if Yes, set the Temperature Module Temperature. Ensure all flow rates are slowed for 1 µL transfers and enable blow‑out steps.

steps.title: Add first cDNA to Supermix
steps.instruction: Aspirate the cDNA from the first user‑specified column (located in Slot 4) using the low flow rate and the defined aspiration height, then dispense it into the Supermix located in column 1, Slot 1. Perform a blow‑out to ensure complete transfer; handle volumes as low as 1 µL.

steps.title: Dispense Mastermix to odd rows
steps.instruction: Distribute the resulting Mastermix from column 1, Slot 1 to the odd rows (A, C, E, G, I, K, M, O) of the 384‑well PCR plate (Slot 2). Transfer four columns at a time, moving across the entire 24‑column tray. Use the reduced flow rates, the set dispense height, and include a blow‑out after each dispense.

substeps.instruction: Dispense into wells of row A for four consecutive columns.
Repeat for rows C, E, G, I, K, M, and O until all 24 columns are filled.

steps.title: Add second cDNA to Supermix
steps.instruction: Aspirate the cDNA from the second user‑specified column (also in Slot 4) and dispense it into the Supermix located in column 2, Slot 2, using the same low‑flow, low‑height settings and a final blow‑out.

steps.title: Dispense Mastermix to even rows
steps.instruction: Distribute the Mastermix from column 2, Slot 2 to the even rows (B, D, F, H, J, L, N, P) of the 384‑well PCR plate (Slot 2). Transfer four columns at a time across the 24‑column tray, using the same slowed flow rates, dispense height, and blow‑out steps as before.

substeps.instruction: Dispense into wells of row B for four consecutive columns.
Repeat for rows D, F, H, J, L, N, and P until the plate is fully populated.

steps.title: Add PrimerPairs to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Distribute PrimerPairs from each column in Slot 3 to the 384‑well PCR plate in Slot 2. First, dispense each PrimerPair to two adjacent columns of the odd rows (A, C, E, G, I, K, M, O); then repeat for the even rows (B, D, F, H, J, L, N, P), creating duplicate reactions for each primer pair. Use the defined low flow rates, heights, and include blow‑out after each dispense.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate PrimerPair from a column in Slot 3.
Dispense into two columns of row A, then row C, etc., for all odd rows.
Repeat the aspiration‑dispense cycle for each PrimerPair column.
After completing odd rows, repeat the process for even rows (B, D, …).
